name: Azel
message: 「Every time this day comes around, I'm reminded... of Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「How ironic. If it weren't for Re-Crea, I would have never met you」

name: Azel
message: 「Nor spent Holy Night together with you like this...」

name: Azel
message: 「Please. Come a little closer... It's a bit cold」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah... You're so warm... Both body and soul...」

name: Azel
message: 「If only time could just stop like this forever...」
